label: dense background feature, amplified by recent s/y inputs
explanation: Fires on 43% of all steps in 97% of sequences, spread fairly evenly across phases, positions, L and tokens; the trivial predicate t>0 already gets F1 0.61 / mass recall 0.97, and no token-set predicate does much better (best was 0.65). It is weak at t=0 (rate 0.27) and at the delimiter step (0.33). What sets the magnitude is recent s or y inputs: the top activations are all sequences that begin s s s (or s y s s), where activation climbs with each repeated s and then decays over the next ~3-5 steps, including into <DEL> and the early copy steps. In the original phase, steps at or after an s/y input are active with precision 0.84, but they cover only 42% of the mass. 1, b, d, t, r and h raise the firing rate more mildly. Steps with no s/y in the history are mostly low-magnitude background activity. The recorded predicate (s/y seen or current) is a partial description of the magnitude driver; it is not a full explanation of where the feature fires.
